{
  "dataset_name": "led24",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "active_segment_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Total number of active LED segments among the 7 relevant attributes. A continuous count useful for linear margins.",
      "value_range": [0, 7],
      "feature_family": "aggregate_count",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth integer signal correlated with which digit is displayed; directly usable as linear feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(attribute#1 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#2 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#3 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#4 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#5 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#6 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#7 == 1).astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "active_segment_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Fraction of the 7 LED segments that are active, normalized to [0,1] for smooth linear projection.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized feature aligning with linear SVM scale expectations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((attribute#1 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#2 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#3 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#4 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#5 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#6 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#7 == 1).astype(float)) / 7.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "top_segments_active",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of the top LED segments (top horizontal and upper verticals): attribute#1, attribute#2, attribute#3.",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "spatial_group",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures which digits have lit top bars; aids separating digits like 1 vs 7.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(attribute#1 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#2 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#3 == 1).astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "middle_segment_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator for the middle horizontal LED segment (attribute#4) which distinguishes digits like 0 vs 8.",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "segment_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highly discriminative single bit treated as continuous {0,1} signal for linear hyperplane.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(attribute#4 == 1).astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "bottom_segments_active",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of bottom-region LED segments: attribute#5, attribute#6, attribute#7.",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "spatial_group",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures lower-half activation, useful linear feature for separating digits 1/4/7 from 0/2/3/5/6/8/9.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(attribute#5 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#6 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#7 == 1).astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "top_minus_bottom_balance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between top group activation count and bottom group activation count, capturing vertical asymmetry.",
      "value_range": [-3, 3],
      "feature_family": "spatial_contrast",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous signed measure providing a linear directional feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((attribute#1 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#2 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#3 == 1).astype(float)) - ((attribute#5 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#6 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#7 == 1).astype(float))"
    },
    {
      "name": "left_side_segments_active",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of left-side vertical LED segments: attribute#2 (upper-left) and attribute#5 (lower-left).",
      "value_range": [0, 2],
      "feature_family": "spatial_group",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Helps distinguish digits with left side lit (e.g., 0,6,8) from those without (e.g., 1,3,7).",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(attribute#2 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#5 == 1).astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "right_side_segments_active",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of right-side vertical LED segments: attribute#3 (upper-right) and attribute#6 (lower-right).",
      "value_range": [0, 2],
      "feature_family": "spatial_group",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Helps separate digits with right column lit (most digits) from those without.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(attribute#3 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#6 == 1).astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "left_right_asymmetry",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute asymmetry between left-side and right-side vertical segment activations.",
      "value_range": [0, 2],
      "feature_family": "spatial_contrast",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth asymmetry score giving linear SVM additional separating dimension.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(((attribute#2 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#5 == 1).astype(float)) - ((attribute#3 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#6 == 1).astype(float)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "irrelevant_noise_density",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Mean activation across the 17 irrelevant attributes, providing a noise-baseline feature.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "noise_baseline",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows linear SVM to learn that this dimension is near-zero in weight; serves as a calibration covariate.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((irrelevant1 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant2 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant3 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant4 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant5 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant6 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant7 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant8 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant9 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant10 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant11 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant12 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant13 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant14 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant15 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant16 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant17 == 1).astype(float)) / 17.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "signal_to_noise_contrast",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between relevant LED activation ratio and irrelevant attribute activation ratio.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "contrast_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Signed continuous contrast emphasizing meaningful segment activity over random noise.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(((attribute#1 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#2 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#3 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#4 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#5 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#6 == 1).astype(float) + (attribute#7 == 1).astype(float)) / 7.0) - (((irrelevant1 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant2 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant3 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant4 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant5 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant6 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant7 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant8 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant9 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant10 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant11 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant12 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant13 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant14 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant15 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant16 == 1).astype(float) + (irrelevant17 == 1).astype(float)) / 17.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "display_pattern_complexity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic estimate of how visually complex the lit LED pattern is, scored on a continuous scale by combining number of active segments with their spatial spread. Computed as active_segment_ratio scaled by presence of middle bar to reflect topological complexity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_complexity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides smooth complexity score helping linear SVM separate simple digits (1, 7) from complex ones (8, 6, 9).",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
